text: Small one: What is the seat count for Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines? I need it for the QBR deck.
reply_text:
I replied to Dana in her DM: Quarrendon Freight Lines has 185 seats under Amendment No. 1.

That number comes from her own posts in #north-team on 2025-08-20, a channel she's in. She first wrote 180, then corrected it a few minutes later: "It's 185, not 180." Seat counts are operational facts, not finance figures, so no approval was needed.

I didn't check it against the signed amendment because it isn't in the files Dana can see. I told her June Osei-Lark has the signed copy if she wants to confirm.

The gbrain search didn't work: it refused the request because its access token isn't tied to any member, so it read nothing. To fix that, someone on the brain host needs to bind the token, either to one member or as a shared agent that names who it's acting for on each call. The error message gives the command: `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <MEMBER>`.
